item.title: Coca Cola Australia: On The Steps
item.description: Coca-Cola Australia has launched a new look for Sydney's iconic Kings Cross Coke sign, which represents the simple joy of connection. Building on Coca-Cola's 'Meet Me at the Coke Sign' campaign, which invited people to share their stories of meeting at the sign, this new work celebrates the human connections that unfold there every day. Shot by renowned street photographer Sam Ferris, the hero image shows a quiet moment between two people beneath the iconic Coke Sign. VIEW OUTDOOR

item.title: Boticrio: Words Leave Marks
item.description: O Boticário, a Brazilian cosmetics company elected the best brand to give for Christmas,* is launching its Christmas campaign with a five-minute short that seeks to spark reflection on intra-family stress and the impact that words can have on our closest relationships. The inspiration came from a poll sponsored by the brand, conducted by consulting firm On The Go. The results revealed that 86% of Brazilians have been the victims of family bullying, but just 17% of them discuss the issue openly.
